transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess… my eating’s been kind of messed up lately. Some days I just forget to eat, and then other nights I’m up late going through takeout or snacks. It felt weird enough that I figured I should come in.
Can you tell me more about the times when you’re going through snacks or takeout—do you feel like you lose control or eat much more than you intend to?

Yeah… sometimes. It’s not like I plan to. I’ll skip meals or just forget during the day, and then after midnight I’m suddenly eating a bunch of takeout or snacks. It feels kind of out of hand, honestly.
Do these eating behaviors cause you a lot of distress or interfere with your daily life?

Yeah… I mean, enough that it scared me into coming in. My eating’s just been all over the place—some days I’ll miss meals completely, and then other nights I’m up after midnight tearing through takeout or snacks. It’s been bothering me.
After these times when you feel like you've eaten a lot or lost control, do you ever make yourself vomit, use laxatives, or exercise a lot to try to balance it out?
No… I don’t think so. I’m not making myself throw up or anything like that. I just kind of feel gross afterward and try not to think about it.
How often do these episodes of eating a lot late at night happen? Are they happening regularly, like at least once a week?

Yeah… I think it’s pretty regular. Not every single night, but often enough that it feels like a pattern. Some days I barely eat, and then other nights after midnight I’m going through takeout or snacks more than I meant to.
Do you usually feel any appetite in the morning, or do you tend to skip breakfast after those late-night eating episodes?
Most mornings I don’t really feel like eating, especially if I was up late eating. I’ll just skip breakfast or kind of forget about it… then later it catches up with me.
When you’re eating during these late-night episodes, do you find yourself eating much faster than usual or feeling uncomfortably full?

Yeah… I mean, it’s not really normal eating. Some days I’ll barely eat or just forget meals, and then other nights after midnight I’m just going through takeout and snacks. That’s honestly part of what scared me enough to come in.
How long has this pattern of late-night eating been going on? Has it happened at least once a week for the past few months?

It’s been… a little while. I don’t know exactly how many months, but yeah, it’s regular enough. Some days I just forget to eat, and then other nights I’m up after midnight going through takeout or snacks. That’s kind of what freaked me out.
When you’re eating during these late-night episodes, do you find yourself eating much faster than usual or feeling uncomfortably full afterward?

Yeah… I guess it can be like that. It’s more that my eating’s just been all over the place — some days I forget meals, and then other nights I’m up after midnight tearing through takeout or snacks. That’s kind of what scared me.
How many times a week do you have these late-night eating episodes where you feel like you're eating a lot or losing control?

I don’t really count it exactly… but it happens enough that it worries me. Some days I just don’t eat much or forget meals, and then other nights, after midnight, I’m tearing through takeout and snacks.
Can you estimate if these late-night eating episodes where you feel like you're eating a lot or losing control have happened at least once a week for the past three months?

Yeah… I think so. I haven’t kept track, but for a while now it’s been like that — some days I barely eat or forget meals, and then some nights I’m up after midnight going through takeout or snacks. That’s honestly what scared me.
During those late-night eating episodes, do you feel like you can't stop eating or control what or how much you're eating?

Yeah… kind of. I mean, it’s not every time, but some nights after midnight I’ll start on takeout or snacks and it feels like I just keep going. Other days I’ll forget meals completely, so it’s all been pretty off.
